回归的云祈仙（回归的云祈仙（第22页）下一刻。云祈仙好似意识到了什么，站着未动，眼中一阵颤动。南海上空，乌云低垂得仿佛触手可及。狂风卷起数十丈高的怒浪，狠狠地拍打在漆黑的暗礁上，发出震耳欲聋的轰鸣声。在这等宛如天地动怒的恶劣天象中，两道流光正以一种肉眼难以捕捉的恐怖速度，一前一后在波涛汹涌的大海上方飞速追逐着。前方那道血色流光，逃得可谓是狼狈至极。雪无痕浑身上下布满了深浅不一、深可见骨的恐怖剑痕。暗红色的鲜血随着他的飞遁，在半空中拉出一条长长的血线，又瞬间被狂风吹散。而在他身后不足千丈的距离，一道犹如大日初升般的白金剑光，正犹如附骨之疽般紧紧咬着不放。雪无痕如今心中可谓是憋屈到了绝点。他堂堂雪崖剑阁之主，曾经纵横南境的绝顶天人境强者，其底蕴之深厚、掌握的妙法之繁多，本该轻易碾压眼前这个年轻的世子。然而，他如今的肉身，却根本发挥不出天人法则的本领，被那天之骄子裴苏碾压，甚至如今他感觉到了真切的死亡气息。如果被裴苏追上，他定然会死在他手上。想到这里，雪无痕大喝道：“裴苏，只要你放我一条生路，这南境的半壁江山，我雪无痕双手奉上！”雪无痕大口喘息着，继续抛出筹码：“我剑阁禁地之中，藏有一条上古遗留的残缺龙脉！只要你点头，那龙脉的阵眼秘钥便是你的！还有……还有我雪崖剑阁积攒了八百年的藏剑楼，里面有三柄法宝神剑，我都可以统统给你！”黑云低垂，两道极速的身影掠过波涛无垠的海面。裴苏听见了声音，脸上却没有泛起一丝波澜，甚至速度再度快了几分，杀意不减。雪无痕彻底急了，眼中闪过一道挣扎，最终喝道：“裴苏！好！我愿服下那枚‘血丹’！愿终生奉你为主，我的性命、神魂彻底由你掌控！”一代剑阁阁主，此刻为了活命，愿意化为奴仆。然而，半空中的裴苏，却发出了一声冷笑。那冷笑声穿透了漫天风暴，犹如丧钟般敲击在雪无痕的心脏上。“晚了。”裴苏吐出这两个冰冷的字眼。下一刻，他再无任何废话。手中凤厌爆发出比之前强烈十倍的璀璨光芒，一道宽达百丈的纯阳剑气，犹如一挂倒悬的银河，携带着焚毁万物的天威，轰然斩向雪无痕。“竖子敢尔！”雪无痕惊骇欲绝，他拼尽最后一丝底蕴，双手托天，试图凝聚出一面护盾。“咔嚓——！”没有任何悬念。那护盾被瞬间撕裂。恐怖的剑压直直地贯穿了雪无痕的胸膛，将他整个人彻底轰飞，他心口欲裂，拼尽了这具身躯最后的力量，在即将掉落海面的那个呼吸，化作缥缈之色遁逃而去。足足半刻钟的遁飞之术，雪无痕最后再无半分力气，坠入了一处荒岛。“噗——”雪无痕跌落在荒岛的一处深坑中，再次喷出一口血，四肢百骸传来的剧痛已经让他麻木。他仰头看着云端，万里无云，海面之上风平浪静，但他知道，他已经逃不掉了，不出一会儿，那裴家小儿便会追上。而自己再无半分力气与之抗衡。想到这里，雪无痕不禁大笑，笑到咳血，笑到眼泪落下。

Chapter 465 The Return of Yun Qixian (Page 1)
The return of Yun Qixian (Return of Yun Qixian (page 22)) The next moment. Yun Qixian seemed to realize something and stood still, with a tremor in his eyes. Over the South China Sea, dark clouds hung so low that they seemed to be within reach. The strong wind rolled up dozens of feet. The high and furious waves crashed hard on the dark reef, making a deafening roar. In this bad celestial phenomenon, which seemed like the heaven and earth were angry, two streams of light were moving one after another at a terrifying speed that was difficult to catch with the naked eye. The bloody stream of light in front of him was chasing him at high speed. Xue Wuhen's body was covered with terrifying sword marks of varying depths, as he flew away. A long line of blood was drawn out in the air, and was instantly blown away by the strong wind. But less than a thousand feet behind him, a white gold sword light was like a rising sun, clinging to Xue Wuhen's heart like a gangrene attached to his bones. It can be said that he is frustrated to the point of despair. He is the master of the Xueya Sword Pavilion, a powerful man in the heavenly realm who once roamed the southern border. With his profound knowledge and many magical skills, he should have easily crushed the young prince in front of him. The current physical body cannot exert the ability of the laws of heaven and man, and is crushed by Pei Su, the proud son of heaven. Even now, he feels the real aura of death. If he is caught up by Pei Su, he will definitely die in his hands. Xue Wuhen shouted: "Pei Su, as long as you let me live, I, Xue Wuhen, will give you half of the southern territory with both hands!" Xue Wuhen panted heavily and continued to throw out chips: "There is an ancient relic hidden in the forbidden area of my sword pavilion. The incomplete dragon vein left behind! As long as you nod, the secret key to the Dragon Vein Formation Eye will be yours! And... there are three magic swords in my Xueya Sword Pavilion that I have accumulated for 800 years. I can give them all to you! , two extremely fast figures flew across the boundless sea. When Pei Su heard the sound, there was no wave on his face, and his speed even became a little faster again. Xue Wuhen was completely anxious, and a struggle flashed in his eyes. Finally shouted: "Pei Su! Okay! I am willing to take that 'blood pill'! I am willing to serve you as my master for the rest of my life, and my life and soul are completely under your control!" A generation of sword pavilion masters are willing to become slaves in order to survive at this moment. However, in mid-air. Pei Su sneered. The sneer penetrated the storm and struck Xue Wuhen's heart like a death knell. "It's too late." The next moment Pei Su spat out these two cold words, he said nothing. Zhongfengyan erupted with a bright light that was ten times stronger than before. A pure Yang sword energy that was a hundred feet wide, like an upside-down Milky Way, carrying the power of heaven that burned all things, slashed towards Xue Wuhen. "How dare you, Shuzi!" Xue Wuhen was horrified. Desperate, he tried his best to hold up the sky with his hands, trying to form a shield. "Crack——!" The shield was torn apart instantly, and the terrifying sword pressed straight through Xue Wuhen's chest. His whole body was completely blown away, and he was heartbroken. He used up the last strength of his body, and when he was about to fall to the sea, the breath turned into a misty color and fled away. After a full half-quarter of an hour of escaping, Xue Wuhen finally lost any strength. He was so angry that he fell into a desert island. "Pfft--" Xue Wuhen fell into a deep pit on the desert island and spat out a mouthful of blood again. The severe pain from his limbs had already made him numb. The sea was calm, but he knew that he could not escape. In a short while, the Pei family's child would catch up, and he no longer had the strength to fight against it. Thinking of this, Xue Wuhen couldn't help laughing until he coughed up blood and burst into tears.
